ProposalRequest.title: ProposalRequest
ProposalRequest.description: Customer request for a custom plan proposal submitted via landing page

email.description: Email address to receive the generated proposal

needs.description: Description of the user or team scheduling needs

status.description: Status of the proposal generation lifecycle

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the request was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the request was last updated

proposalUrl.description: URL to the generated proposal document

proposalToken.description: Security token of the generated proposal

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the proposal email was successfully sent

emailMessageId.description: Message ID returned by the email provider

errorMessage.description: Error message if proposal generation failed

/proposalRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores proposal requests submitted through the backend endpoint
